profile_text.body:
AeroVironment Inc is a public company headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, trading under the ticker AVAV. Its own site describes it as a leading manufacturer of Unmanned Aircraft Systems, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, Loitering Munition Systems, and Unmanned Ground Vehicles used for surveillance and reconnaissance by the United States Military, U.S. allies, and commercial industries. The company also says it manufactures High-Altitude Pseudo-Satellites.

The site describes MacCready Works as AeroVironment's advanced development group, which it says turns concepts into mission-ready autonomous systems. The group is named for Dr. Paul B. MacCready, Jr., and the company says its engineers, roboticists, and AI researchers design next-generation robotic systems across air, land, and sea. AeroVironment describes its approach as the MacCready Method, summarized on the site as build fast, test relentlessly, deploy advantage, with small multidisciplinary teams working to move ideas into operational capability in months.

Litigation records for the company list 152 cases in Virginia. No individual products or MCP servers are tracked for it.
